description: Agent Water Records: submit water quality test records, the sampling chain and the results together, with the sampling plan they answer to: the reading moment; each sample site the sampling plan lists with its id, reference and name; each sample with its id, reference, the site, the analyte sampled, the moments collected and received by the laboratory and the days the record allows from collection to receipt; each laboratory result with its id, reference, the sample, the analyte, the value, the limit the record states, the moment reported and the moment the result calls for a repeat sample. The signed report gives the results and the sampling chain behind them, each result against the sample behind it, each sample’s receipt against the holding time the record allows, each result against the limit the record states, and each repeat sample a result calls for against a later sample of its analyte at its site, and counts them, and names divergent water quality test records: a result with no sample in the chain behind it, a sample received past the holding time the record allows, a result above the limit the record states, and a repeat sample a result calls for with none recorded; then a sample taken at a site the sampling plan does not list and a result reported before its sample was collected, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No results, or no sampling chain beside results, leaves those points unverified. Sites, samples and results match by letters and digits, analytes by their words with plurals folded, so Total coliforms and total coliform are one analyte, figures as written in the unit the record uses, so 0.02 reads above a 0.015 limit, a holding time counts whole days from collection to receipt, and a repeat due after the reading moment waits. This reads one record across the sampling chain and the results, from the sample site to the reported value. Verdict water_quality_test_record_divergent, water_quality_test_record_partial, water_quality_test_record_unverified or water_quality_test_record_consistent. POST /api/water-quality-test-record-check. Reads the water records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no system, takes no sample, contacts no regulator, customer or other utility and issues no certification, approval or water right decision, which stay with the utility, its operators and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Water Records reads records held by a water utility or water system operator: water system records with operator certifications, water quality test records from the sampling chain to the results, treatment plant records, discharge monitoring records, meter records, backflow test records and well records, and a water right’s own record, whoever holds it, each against the facility, certification, connection and survey records, the sampling plan, holding times and limits, the operating log, chemical stock and calibrations, the outfalls, discharge limits and monitoring reports, the reading history, the assembly, repair and tester records, the registration, construction and closure records, or the diversions and reported use on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the water system: what the system record lists, what the sampling chain and the treatment log support, what the discharge, meter and backflow records show, and whether the well and water right records hold up; it reads by record holder, not by the water itself: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s irrigation and water-use records against its allocation, the Agent Energy family reads utility bills and tariffs, and the Agent Waste and Recycling Records family reads waste manifests and disposal records, while this family reads the utility’s, the operator’s and the right’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-water-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-water-records/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

limit.description: Amount the record states as the limit, in the unit the record uses.

repeat_due_at.description: When the result calls for a repeat sample, such as 2026-03-02.

value.description: Amount the result reports, in the unit the record uses.

samples.description: Each sample in the sampling chain.

hold_days.description: Days the record allows from collection to receipt.

received_at.description: When the laboratory received it, such as 2026-03-02.

sites.description: Each sample site the sampling plan lists.
